exposure: Two distinct periods: 2009-2011 (initial period) and 2017-2018 (current period)
Implementation of protocol-based multidisciplinary quality improvement (QI) care bundles
cohort: 105 patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for radiologically suspected and pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
finding: Implementation of QI care bundles was associated with reduced blood loss, fewer blood transfusions, improved postoperative hemoglobin levels, and shorter hospital stays in women undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for PAS disorders.
